goal: Catalog usable rigged avatar files without requiring VRM when another interoperable rigged model format is actually available.

vrm.validation: GLB 2.0 plus VRM or VRMC_vrm extension

glb.validation: GLB 2.0 plus at least one mesh and a glTF skin containing joint nodes
glb.warning: A plain GLB without a skin/joint rig is 3D model evidence, not an avatar-ready asset.

fbx.validation: Recognizable FBX bytes plus an explicit research claim that the asset is rigged, backed by rigging/avatar documentation or equivalent source evidence
fbx.warning: The .fbx extension alone never proves avatar readiness.

mml.role: Runtime definition and model-discovery surface. Resolve referenced model files, then validate those files independently.

completeness.rule: One exhaustive supported avatar representation lane is sufficient. A collection does not need to ship VRM if an exhaustive rigged GLB or rigged FBX lane is available.
completeness.partial_sets: Useful and retained, but do not satisfy collection completeness.
completeness.holder_gated_sets: Valid assets, but still require explicit inventory and ownership/access semantics; holder gating is not a no-link escape hatch.
completeness.terminal_state: not_shipped or unrecoverable may close the broader avatar inventory only when evidence addresses usable avatar models generally. A legacy VRM-only not_shipped finding does not rule out GLB or FBX.
